hero.heading: Complete Solutions for Woodworking and Modular Industries
hero.supportingText: Modu Pro Innovation Pvt. Ltd. brings together Adhhesive products, precision woodworking blades, panel-processing machinery and furniture hardware to support manufacturers across the woodworking and modular-furniture industry.

aboutContent.overviewParagraphOne: Modu Pro Innovation Pvt. Ltd. serves the needs of modular furniture, kitchen, door and woodworking manufacturers through a focused range of products and industry solutions. The company brings together Adhhesive products, woodworking blades, panel-processing machinery and furniture hardware under one business, helping customers explore related products and services through a single point of contact.
aboutContent.overviewParagraphTwo: Our goal is to support manufacturers with relevant products, dependable communication and practical assistance for their woodworking requirements.
aboutContent.approachText: Every manufacturing floor operates with distinct panel substrates, production volumes, and machinery setups. Rather than offering generic off-the-shelf packages, our four divisions coordinate to help furniture, kitchen, and door manufacturers identify suitable Adhhesives, tooling, panel-processing equipment, spare parts, and hardware fittings through structured consultation.

footer.summaryText: Integrated industrial solutions across Adhhesi Pro Adhhesives, PCD & TCT woodworking saw blades, panel-processing machinery, and PVC edge-banding tapes & furniture hardware.
